text:
Ben: heads-up — we should gate config-snapshot apply on SLO delta, not just error counts.
Maya: +1. which SLO are we targeting? p99 latency or error-rate? :thinking_face:
Ben: primarily p99 serving latency. and error-rate > 0.5% sustained over 5m should block.
Alex: also consider cost spike metric — some model-quant changes can increase token cost unexpectedly.
Priya: +1 on cost. dashboard should show estimated token-cost delta per snapshot.
Ben: ops question — do we reuse trace tags for snapshot operations? e.g. `trace:config.snapshot_id` so we can tie traces to applies.
Maya: we already have `cfg.snap_id` in traces, but not consistently emitted by the console apply path. I'll add it.
Jordan: UX question: when an apply is blocked by SLO, should the console show a "blocked by SLO" banner and an escape hatch?
Maya: no escape hatch for self-serve in first 24h. override only via ops-approved override with audit reason.
Ben: proposed minimal API: POST /v1/configs/{id}/apply?force=true (ops-only).
Priya: prefer a body shape for extensibility: POST /v1/configs/{id}/apply with {"action":"apply","force":true,"reason":"..."}.
Ben: agreed. that lets us add dry_run/cohort later.
Alex: telemetry plan: emit metric `config_apply_attempt_total{result=\"blocked|applied|forced\"}` and a histogram `config_apply_latency_seconds`.
Priya: for dashboard, panels: snapshot diff heatmap, affected-route-count, affected-qps, SLO delta timeseries, estimated-cost-delta.
Maya: can someone mock a panel layout? I'll add a checklist to the ops runbook.
Jordan: I can do a quick UX mock. will post in #design by EOD.
Ben: ops-bot: please create runbook ticket for the gating behavior and ownership.
ops-bot: created ticket RF-438 and assigned to @Maya, @Ben — https://tickets/redwood/RF-438 :white_check_mark:
Priya: sample logs we should emit (structured):
```
cfg_apply id=abc123 initiator=ben result=blocked reason=\"p99_up_0.8%\" snapshot_id=abc123 target_cohort=100%
cfg_apply id=abc123 initiator=ben result=applied latency_ms=123 snapshot_id=abc123 affected_routes=42
```
Maya: guardrail: if we see 3 blocked apply attempts for the same snapshot in 1h, auto-notify oncall and escalate.
Alex: also a preview/dry-run API: GET /v1/configs/{id}/preview?cohort=10% — returns diff + estimated impact metrics.
Maya: absolutely. preview must respect routing policy substitutions and show per-route counts.
Ben: timeline? can we land API + telemetry by Thu and console changes next week?
Maya: API + telemetry by Thu AM is tight but possible if we scope initial telemetry to apply attempt + result + latency. console panels next week.
Jordan: UX mock by Fri morning.
Priya: I'll scaffold dashboard templates and the Grafana panels today.
Ben: SRE — any infra objections (quota spikes, metric cardinality)?
SRE: looks reasonable. watch cardinality on snapshot_id label — recommend rollup metrics (snapshot_id only for logs/traces, not as a cardinality label in metrics).
Maya: noted — we'll keep snapshot_id off high-cardinality metrics and use tag in traces/logs instead.
Ben: ok thanks. next steps: Priya wires dashboard, Maya adds trace tag + guardrail logic, Alex adds cost metric calc, Jordan posts mock. follow-up in RF-438. :rocket:
